title: All Expedition 33 Boss Drops & Rewards - Full Index
description: Every optional boss reward in Expedition 33 in one table: Pictos, weapons, Chroma Catalysts and Colours of Lumina, with locations.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
A single cross-reference table of what every optional boss in Expedition 33 drops and where to find it. Useful when you are hunting a specific Pictos or weapon and do not want to open twenty separate pages.

Rewards marked — are bosses where a specific drop list has not been documented. We list what is verified rather than guessing.

sections.title: The Drops Actually Worth Chasing
sections.content:
Cheater (Sprong)

Lets an equipped character act twice in a row. Widely considered one of the strongest Pictos in the game, and the reason to put Sprong first on your Act 3 boss list.

Energy Master (Serpenphare)

Raises AP gained from any source by 1. Compounds with everything else in a build.

Colour of Lumina x100 - do not fight Blanche

The single largest Colour of Lumina reward in the game comes from not fighting her. Sparing every friendly White Nevron earns 100 Colour of Lumina; killing her earns 10. See the Blanche page.

sections.title: How to Read This
sections.content:
• Chromatic-tier bosses drop Resplendent and Grandiose Chroma Catalysts, plus weapons and Pictos
  • Colour of Lumina is the limiter on how many Lumina effects you can equip - bosses are one of the best sources
  • For how these rewards feed into your build, see our damage mechanics and character stats guides
